content: Primary streaming-ASR research consistently treats endpointing as a latency/accuracy tradeoff: late endpoints increase perceived latency while early endpoints truncate or fragment speech. Local Meetily evidence is stronger and more specific: live VAD closes only after 500 ms qualifying silence, has no bounded continuous-speech segment, feeds unbounded channels, and uses one ordered worker. Validation must measure spoken-token-to-visible age and backlog under uninterrupted speech and overload, not model inference alone.
